visualCharacteristics.description: Rounded (24px), centered CTA panel: optional 48px white line icon, Tomorrow h2 (heading-l scale), optional paragraph(s), white small pill CTA (full width on mobile, auto >=900px; external links get an external-link glyph). Gradient option: blue-to-black vertical gradient. Age-input option: small note above a 64px white floating-label field (max 402px); the submit button appears only once a valid age (18-105) is entered and navigates to the CTA link with ?age=<value> (new tab for off-site links).

contentPattern: Row 1, 1 cell: icon (optional, standalone :icon: or image paragraph), h2, paragraph(s) (optional), CTA link (last link). Option 'age-input': the last link is turned into a form (its text = submit button text, its href = destination); a short paragraph directly above the CTA (after the description) renders as a small note; optional row 2 = field label (e.g. 'Enter your age') | query parameter name (default 'age'). When row 2 is omitted the CTA text is used as the field label. Clear-button label comes from placeholders key 'Clear input'.

options.label: Age input (inline age field with CTA)
